game_title: Sentinel Loop – Exit Light Ledge Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge, a ledge toward daylight: the spelunker must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Sentinel Loop: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word.
theme: Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge: a ledge toward daylight
core_gameplay_loop: In Exit Light Ledge, repeat each round: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the queue_length value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about queue_length to power up the spelunker and open the stone seal.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Sentinel Loop
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
